step_by_step_approach: Gather the points earned by each constructor for each year.
Gather the points earned by each driver for each year.
For each constructor in each year, identify the driver with the highest points.
Add the constructor's points to that driver's points to obtain a combined total for each constructor-year.
Rank all constructor-year combinations by their combined total in descending order.
Select the three highest combined totals.
Return the names of those constructors together with the years in which they achieved the top combined totals.
